final_markdown:
## The chairman's final synthesis

The question was whether the market has caught up with the growth story. It has. At 24.1 times forward earnings against a five-year average near 20, the shares are about a fifth above their own history, and the earnings yield sits under the risk-free rate even before the stale treasury reading is refreshed.

The challenger pressed two points. On the first, the cash-flow rating now stands beside the earnings multiple and tells the same story. On the second, the reopening prices below already assume a demand downturn, so it changes nothing.

The final view is a watch-state, not an opinion to act on: no view yet, watch the named triggers. Reopen at or under 72.00, or on the 2027-02-04 full-year print, whichever comes first. A close under 84.50 kills the reopening case itself.
